purpose: Additional physical sensor separation if previous neural rounds miss MAE500: Terra/Aqua features and modality-fusion Transformer
features: V5 fine features plus42 separate Terra/Aqua count, day/night count, FRP, thermal contrast, confidence, geometry, detection-day occupancy and approximate solar acquisition time descriptors from existing raw MODIS data. Detector-only, not exposure masks.
architecture: Two training-only month-specific reference-per-platform count scales; neural corrections and learned softmax fusion weights. MLP control or full two-layer32dim4head Transformer over Terra/Aqua modality tokens plus CLS. Pure neural count mean, no boosted teacher.
optimizer: MPS AdamW lr .001 weight_decay .01, dropout .1, clip5, cosine .0001 floor over320 epochs, eight full months per batch
loss: Same v7 positive-only conditional Poisson, .2 BCE and direct statewide/regional monthly losses, coefficient per config.
selection_rule: Choose epoch on2019-2020 ensemble MAE, refit2013-2020, select config on2021-2022 only. Seal choice before new winner benchmark. No known-benchmark tuning.
limits: Exploratory repeated historical selection. Different nominal Terra/Aqua observation times motivate feature separation, not a claim that either sensor is always superior. Historical Terra-only periods are an unvalidated platform-availability shift. No production promotion.
